status: Installed small iPhone Simulator cloud project selection: A → B → A → logout accepted; other hosts/sizes remain open

accepted.scope: Native gallery installs small My list; selects cloud project A; opens exact task A. Initial screenshot was a placeholder and is not visual acceptance.
B to A native authentication; original installed A selection retained without reconfiguration; exact A task route; settled screenshot inspected.

foreignAccount.historicalFailure: Browse tap after sign-in; widget assertions never reached. Video frame at 25 seconds shows system Save Password prompt covering app. SpringBoard-only Not Now query did not dismiss it. Diagnostic v3 starts from B and is not an A-to-B acceptance run.
foreignAccount.historicalPartialEvidence: Separate App Group inspection found only account B task/list; private server workspaces unchanged. This is not installed widget rendering or routing acceptance.
foreignAccount.resolution: Native XCTest queries Not Now in com.apple.SafariViewService before SpringBoard fallback. v6 logs confirm actual service button tap; Browse, installed foreign-selection fallback and exact B task ownership assertions then pass. Generic XCTest interruption monitor v5 did not handle the prompt and was removed.
foreignAccount.visual: Shows generic My list / Choose your list, no A names. Native widget tap opens B All tasks containing only B task.

ios.logout: v6 native sign-out, termination, relaunch to authentication, installed widget screenshot with no private names; shared account empty, zero tasks/lists.
ios.fixtureReuse: Recreated the two deleted disposable accounts/project/task IDs with fresh passwords to preserve the existing installed widget selection. No widget reconfiguration during v6 A/B/A/logout. Both fresh server workspaces verified unchanged after every phase.

mac.scope: Actual authenticated owner-scoped reads A/B/A, Mac-owned projection rejects foreign list and restores original A key/task. No Mac GUI or Keychain access.

remaining: Remaining widget sizes/surfaces and physical/iPad/Mac hosts.
Other widget families retain their documented cloud-account lifecycle scope.
Existing P0 external gates and VoiceOver/keyboard journeys remain open.

reproduction.iosRunner: Scripts/test_mylist_account_isolation.py --help; requires freshly provisioned disposable private fixtures and isolated signed Simulator products. Caller must revoke/delete fixtures afterwards.
reproduction.mac: TASKFOLD_MYLIST_ACCOUNT_FIXTURES=<private fixture JSON> swift test --filter MyListAccountIntegrationTests. No fixture means explicit skip, never a pass.
